title: ProfileKeys
description: Allows the creation of profiles for your key binds.
body:
# ProfileKeys
A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that lets you create and switch between multiple Minecraft keybind profiles directly from the Controls menu.

Inspired by profile systems in competitive games like Valorant, KeyProfiles makes it easy to keep separate control setups for different playstyles, servers, or activities.

## Features
Create multiple keybinding profiles
Save and load profiles instantly
Rename and delete profiles
Integrated directly into the Controls screen
Stores profiles locally as JSON files
Supports vanilla and modded keybinds

## Example Use Cases
PvP keybinds
Building keybinds
Minigame setups
Accessibility layouts
Different profiles for different keyboards/devices

## Important
This mod does NOT:

automate gameplay
modify movement
add macros
swap profiles automatically

Profiles can only be changed manually through the settings menu.

## Compatibility
Fabric
Minecraft 1.21.11
Client-side only

## Status
Full Release (video pending)

This mod is still in active development.
You may encounter bugs, UI issues, or incomplete features.

Feedback and bug reports are appreciated.
